newsitem.title: UK: Card Clear forms Internet security business.
newsitem.headline: Card Clear forms Internet security business.

text.p: British card payment and fraud prevention service Card Clear Plc said on Monday it would set up an Internet security joint venture with JCP Computer Services.
The new company, named Inter Clear, will issue security certificates to Internet users, Card Clear said in a statement.

The company said security concerns were considered the biggest barrier to the spread of electronic commerce, the fastest growing area of Internet use. It said Visa credit card transactions were rising at 450 percent per annum.
